decisions.reason: The product shows a clearly positive customer value signal with quantified savings, and in a growing, innovative firm with slack and a close fit to the core offer this exceeds likely aspirations and supports retention.

As a close-to-core machine with dedicated presentation and no sign of failure, it is likely to be given more time because the firm is growing and can absorb early uncertainty while learning from the launch.

Because it is presented as a flagship aligned with the firm's modular environmental-technology direction, management would likely keep it unless results were clearly below aspiration, which is not indicated here.

Although it has weaker market signals than the more emphasized products, it is still close to the established business and a growing firm with organizational slack would usually retain it for another year rather than exit quickly.
